description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: The risen Jesus tells the apostles to wait in Jerusalem for the promise of the Father, the Holy Spirit, and is taken up into heaven. The believers pray together, and Matthias is chosen to take the place of Judas.
1.sw: Yesu aliyefufuka anawaambia mitume wangoje Yerusalemu ahadi ya Baba, yaani Roho Mtakatifu, na kuchukuliwa juu mbinguni. Waamini wanaomba pamoja, naye Mathia anachaguliwa kuchukua nafasi ya Yuda.
1.am: ከሙታን የተነሣው ኢየሱስ ሐዋርያት የአብን የተስፋ ቃል፣ መንፈስ ቅዱስን፣ በኢየሩሳሌም እንዲጠብቁ ይነግራቸዋል፤ ወደ ሰማይም ይወሰዳል። አማኞቹ በአንድነት ይጸልያሉ፤ ማትያስም በይሁዳ ስፍራ ይመረጣል።

2.en: On the day of Pentecost the Holy Spirit comes on the believers, and they speak in other languages. Peter tells the crowd that God raised Jesus and made Jesus Lord, about three thousand are baptized, and the believers share their lives and possessions.
2.sw: Siku ya Pentekoste Roho Mtakatifu anawashukia waamini, nao wanasema kwa lugha nyingine. Petro anauambia umati kwamba Mungu alimfufua Yesu na kumfanya Yesu kuwa Bwana, watu wapatao elfu tatu wanabatizwa, na waamini wanashirikiana maisha yao na mali zao.
2.am: በበዓለ ሃምሳ ቀን መንፈስ ቅዱስ በአማኞቹ ላይ ይወርዳል፤ እነርሱም በሌሎች ቋንቋዎች ይናገራሉ። ጴጥሮስ እግዚአብሔር ኢየሱስን ከሙታን እንዳስነሣውና ጌታ እንዳደረገው ለሕዝቡ ይናገራል፤ ሦስት ሺህ ያህል ሰዎች ይጠመቃሉ፤ አማኞቹም ሕይወታቸውንና ንብረታቸውን ይካፈላሉ።

3.en: Peter and John heal a man lame from birth at the temple gate. In Solomon's Porch Peter tells the astonished crowd that this was done in the name of Jesus, whom God raised, and calls them to repent and turn back.
3.sw: Petro na Yohana wanamponya mtu aliyekuwa kiwete tangu kuzaliwa kwenye lango la hekalu. Katika Ukumbi wa Sulemani Petro anauambia umati uliostaajabu kwamba jambo hili limefanyika kwa jina la Yesu, ambaye Mungu alimfufua, na kuwaita watubu na kurudi.
3.am: ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስ በቤተ መቅደሱ በር ላይ ከተወለደ ጀምሮ አንካሳ የነበረውን ሰው ይፈውሳሉ። በሰሎሞን መመላለሻ ጴጥሮስ ለተደነቀው ሕዝብ ይህ የተደረገው እግዚአብሔር ከሙታን ባስነሣው በኢየሱስ ስም እንደ ሆነ ይነግራቸዋል፤ ንስሓ እንዲገቡና እንዲመለሱም ይጠራቸዋል።

4.en: Peter and John are taken into custody and tell the council that there is salvation in no other name under heaven. Released, they and the believers pray for boldness, and the believers share everything with one heart and soul.
4.sw: Petro na Yohana wanakamatwa na kuliambia Baraza Kuu kwamba hakuna wokovu kwa jina lingine lolote chini ya mbingu. Baada ya kuachiliwa, wao pamoja na waamini wanaomba ujasiri, na waamini wanashirikiana kila kitu wakiwa na moyo mmoja na roho moja.
4.am: ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስ ይታሰራሉ፤ ከሰማይ በታች በሌላ በማንም ስም መዳን እንደሌለም ለሸንጎው ይናገራሉ። ከተፈቱ በኋላ ከአማኞቹ ጋር ሆነው ድፍረትን ለማግኘት ይጸልያሉ፤ አማኞቹም በአንድ ልብና በአንድ ነፍስ ሆነው ሁሉን ይካፈላሉ።

5.en: Ananias and Sapphira lie about their gift and fall dead. The apostles do many signs, an angel opens the prison doors, and before the council they answer that they must obey God rather than people; Gamaliel advises the council to leave them alone.
5.sw: Anania na Safira wanadanganya kuhusu sadaka yao na kuanguka wakiwa wamekufa. Mitume wanafanya ishara nyingi, malaika anafungua milango ya gereza, na mbele ya Baraza Kuu wanajibu kwamba ni lazima kumtii Mungu kuliko wanadamu; Gamalieli analishauri Baraza Kuu liwaache.
5.am: ሐናንያና ሰጲራ ስለ ስጦታቸው ይዋሻሉ፤ ወድቀውም ይሞታሉ። ሐዋርያት ብዙ ምልክቶችን ያደርጋሉ፤ መልአክ የወኅኒውን በሮች ይከፍታል፤ በሸንጎውም ፊት ከሰው ይልቅ እግዚአብሔርን መታዘዝ እንደሚገባቸው ይመልሳሉ፤ ገማልያልም ሸንጎው እንዲተዋቸው ይመክራል።

6.en: Seven men, Stephen among them, are chosen to serve the widows so the apostles can give themselves to prayer and the word. The word grows, and Stephen is seized and brought before the council on false charges.
6.sw: Wanaume saba, Stefano akiwa mmoja wao, wanachaguliwa kuwahudumia wajane ili mitume wajitoe kwa sala na kwa neno. Neno linaenea, naye Stefano anakamatwa na kuletwa mbele ya Baraza Kuu kwa mashtaka ya uongo.
6.am: ሐዋርያት ለጸሎትና ለቃሉ ራሳቸውን እንዲሰጡ፣ እስጢፋኖስን ጨምሮ ሰባት ሰዎች መበለቶችን እንዲያገለግሉ ይመረጣሉ። ቃሉ ያድጋል፤ እስጢፋኖስም ተይዞ በሐሰት ክስ በሸንጎው ፊት ይቀርባል።

7.en: Stephen answers the council with the story of Israel from Abraham through Joseph, Moses and the tent in the wilderness to the house Solomon built, and accuses them of resisting the Holy Spirit. Stephen sees the Son of Man at God's right hand and is stoned, with Saul looking on.
7.sw: Stefano analijibu Baraza Kuu kwa historia ya Israeli kuanzia Abrahamu kupitia Yusufu, Musa na hema jangwani hadi nyumba aliyoijenga Sulemani, na kuwashtaki kwamba wanampinga Roho Mtakatifu. Stefano anamwona Mwana wa Adamu mkono wa kuume wa Mungu na kupigwa mawe, huku Sauli akitazama.
7.am: እስጢፋኖስ ከአብርሃም ጀምሮ በዮሴፍ፣ በሙሴና በምድረ በዳው ድንኳን በኩል ሰሎሞን እስከ ሠራው ቤት ድረስ ባለው የእስራኤል ታሪክ ለሸንጎው ይመልሳል፤ መንፈስ ቅዱስን እንደሚቃወሙም ይከስሳቸዋል። እስጢፋኖስ የሰው ልጅን በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ያያል፤ ሳውል እየተመለከተም በድንጋይ ይወገራል።

8.en: After Stephen's death the church is scattered, and Saul tries to destroy it. Philip proclaims the good news in Samaria, where Simon who practiced magic is rebuked, and on the desert road Philip baptizes an Ethiopian official.
8.sw: Baada ya kifo cha Stefano kanisa linatawanyika, naye Sauli anajaribu kuliangamiza. Filipo anahubiri habari njema huko Samaria, ambako Simoni aliyekuwa akifanya uchawi anakemewa, na katika barabara ya jangwani Filipo anambatiza afisa kutoka Ethiopia.
8.am: ከእስጢፋኖስ ሞት በኋላ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ትበተናለች፤ ሳውልም ሊያጠፋት ይሞክራል። ፊልጶስ በሰማርያ የምሥራቹን ይሰብካል፤ በዚያም ጥንቆላ ያደርግ የነበረው ስምዖን ይገሠጻል፤ በምድረ በዳው መንገድ ላይም ፊልጶስ አንድ ኢትዮጵያዊ ባለ ሥልጣንን ያጠምቃል።

9.en: On the road to Damascus the risen Lord confronts Saul, who is blinded and then healed and baptized by Ananias. Saul proclaims Jesus in Damascus and Jerusalem, and Peter heals Aeneas at Lydda and raises Tabitha at Joppa.
9.sw: Katika barabara ya kwenda Dameski Bwana aliyefufuka anamkabili Sauli, ambaye anapofushwa kisha anaponywa na kubatizwa na Anania. Sauli anamhubiri Yesu huko Dameski na Yerusalemu, naye Petro anamponya Ainea huko Lida na kumfufua Tabitha huko Yafa.
9.am: ወደ ደማስቆ በሚወስደው መንገድ ላይ ከሙታን የተነሣው ጌታ ሳውልን ይገጥመዋል፤ ሳውልም ይታወራል፤ ከዚያም ሐናንያ ይፈውሰዋል፣ ያጠምቀዋልም። ሳውል በደማስቆና በኢየሩሳሌም ኢየሱስን ይሰብካል፤ ጴጥሮስም በልዳ ኤንያን ይፈውሳል፣ በኢዮጴም ጣቢታን ከሞት ያስነሣል።

10.en: An angel tells Cornelius, a Roman centurion, to send for Peter, while Peter sees a vision teaching that what God has made clean is not to be called unclean. In Cornelius's house Peter preaches that God does not favor one person over another, and the Holy Spirit is poured out on the Gentiles.
10.sw: Malaika anamwambia Kornelio, akida wa Kirumi, amwite Petro, huku Petro akiona maono yanayofundisha kwamba kile ambacho Mungu amekitakasa kisiitwe najisi. Nyumbani kwa Kornelio Petro anahubiri kwamba Mungu hampendelei mtu mmoja kuliko mwingine, naye Roho Mtakatifu anamwagwa juu ya watu wa mataifa.
10.am: መልአክ የሮማዊውን የመቶ አለቃ ቆርኔሌዎስን ጴጥሮስን እንዲያስጠራ ይነግረዋል፤ ጴጥሮስም እግዚአብሔር ያነጻውን ርኩስ ማለት እንደማይገባ የሚያስተምር ራእይ ያያል። በቆርኔሌዎስ ቤት ጴጥሮስ እግዚአብሔር ለማንም እንደማያዳላ ይሰብካል፤ መንፈስ ቅዱስም በአሕዛብ ላይ ይፈስሳል።

11.en: Peter tells the believers in Jerusalem what happened in Caesarea, and they praise God for giving repentance to the Gentiles. The good news reaches Antioch, where the disciples are first called Christians, and they send help to Judea in a famine.
11.sw: Petro anawaeleza waamini wa Yerusalemu yaliyotukia Kaisaria, nao wanamsifu Mungu kwa kuwapa watu wa mataifa toba. Habari njema zinafika Antiokia, ambapo wanafunzi wanaitwa Wakristo kwa mara ya kwanza, nao wanatuma msaada Uyahudi wakati wa njaa.
11.am: ጴጥሮስ በቂሣርያ የሆነውን በኢየሩሳሌም ላሉ አማኞች ይነግራቸዋል፤ እነርሱም ለአሕዛብ ንስሓን ስለ ሰጠ እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግናሉ። የምሥራቹ አንጾኪያ ይደርሳል፤ በዚያም ደቀ መዛሙርቱ በመጀመሪያ ክርስቲያኖች ተብለው ይጠራሉ፤ በረሃብም ጊዜ ወደ ይሁዳ ርዳታ ይልካሉ።

12.en: Herod kills James and imprisons Peter, but an angel leads Peter out of prison to the house where Rhoda answers the gate. Herod accepts the people's praise as a god and dies, and the word of God keeps growing.
12.sw: Herode anamuua Yakobo na kumfunga Petro gerezani, lakini malaika anamtoa Petro gerezani hadi kwenye nyumba ambapo Roda anaitikia mlangoni. Herode anakubali sifa za watu kama mungu na kufa, na neno la Mungu linaendelea kuenea.
12.am: ሄሮድስ ያዕቆብን ይገድላል፤ ጴጥሮስንም ያስራል፤ መልአክ ግን ጴጥሮስን ከወኅኒ አውጥቶ ሮዳ በሩን ወደምትከፍትበት ቤት ይመራዋል። ሄሮድስ ሕዝቡ እንደ አምላክ የሰጡትን ውዳሴ ይቀበላል፤ ይሞታልም፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል ማደጉን ይቀጥላል።

13.en: The Spirit sets apart Barnabas and Saul, who on Cyprus confront a magician before the proconsul. In the synagogue at Antioch Paul proclaims Jesus as the fulfillment of God's promise, and when many reject the message, the apostles turn to the Gentiles.
13.sw: Roho anawatenga Barnaba na Sauli, ambao huko Kipro wanampinga mchawi mbele ya mkuu wa jimbo. Katika sinagogi la Antiokia Paulo anamhubiri Yesu kama utimizo wa ahadi ya Mungu, na wengi wanapoukataa ujumbe, mitume wanawageukia watu wa mataifa.
13.am: መንፈስ በርናባስንና ሳውልን ይለያቸዋል፤ እነርሱም በቆጵሮስ በአገረ ገዥው ፊት አንድን አስማተኛ ይቃወማሉ። በአንጾኪያ ምኩራብ ጳውሎስ ኢየሱስን የእግዚአብሔር የተስፋ ቃል ፍጻሜ አድርጎ ይሰብካል፤ ብዙዎች መልእክቱን ሲቃወሙ ሐዋርያት ወደ አሕዛብ ይመለሳሉ።

14.en: In Iconium many believe, but the apostles must flee. At Lystra the crowd calls Paul and Barnabas gods after a lame man is healed, then Paul is stoned and left for dead, and the two return through the cities to Antioch.
14.sw: Huko Ikonio wengi wanaamini, lakini mitume wanalazimika kukimbia. Huko Listra umati unawaita Paulo na Barnaba miungu baada ya kiwete kuponywa, kisha Paulo anapigwa mawe na kuachwa akidhaniwa amekufa, nao wawili hao wanarudi kupitia miji hadi Antiokia.
14.am: በኢቆንዮን ብዙዎች ያምናሉ፤ ሐዋርያት ግን መሸሽ ግድ ይሆንባቸዋል። በልስጥራ አንድ አንካሳ ከተፈወሰ በኋላ ሕዝቡ ጳውሎስንና በርናባስን አማልክት ብለው ይጠሯቸዋል፤ ከዚያም ጳውሎስ በድንጋይ ተወግሮ እንደ ሞተ ተቆጥሮ ይተዋል፤ ሁለቱም በከተሞቹ በኩል ወደ አንጾኪያ ይመለሳሉ።

15.en: In Jerusalem the apostles and elders consider whether Gentile believers must be circumcised, and James proposes that they need not. A letter is sent to the Gentile believers, and Paul and Barnabas go separate ways after a sharp disagreement.
15.sw: Huko Yerusalemu mitume na wazee wanatafakari kama waamini wa mataifa lazima watahiriwe, naye Yakobo anapendekeza kwamba si lazima. Barua inatumwa kwa waamini wa mataifa, na Paulo na Barnaba wanaachana baada ya kutokubaliana vikali.
15.am: በኢየሩሳሌም ሐዋርያትና ሽማግሌዎች ከአሕዛብ የሆኑ አማኞች መገረዝ ይገባቸው እንደ ሆነ ይመረምራሉ፤ ያዕቆብም አያስፈልጋቸውም ብሎ ሐሳብ ያቀርባል። ከአሕዛብ ለሆኑ አማኞች ደብዳቤ ይላካል፤ ጳውሎስና በርናባስም ከጽኑ አለመግባባት በኋላ ይለያያሉ።

16.en: Timothy joins Paul and Silas, and a vision calls them to Macedonia. In Philippi Lydia believes, a slave girl is freed from a spirit, and after an earthquake at midnight the jailer and his household are baptized; the magistrates release Paul and Silas, who are Roman citizens.
16.sw: Timotheo anajiunga na Paulo na Sila, na maono yanawaita kwenda Makedonia. Huko Filipi Lidia anaamini, msichana mtumwa anawekwa huru kutoka kwa pepo, na baada ya tetemeko la ardhi usiku wa manane mlinzi wa gereza na nyumba yake wanabatizwa; mahakimu wanawaachilia Paulo na Sila, ambao ni raia wa Kirumi.
16.am: ጢሞቴዎስ ከጳውሎስና ከሲላስ ጋር ይቀላቀላል፤ ራእይም ወደ መቄዶንያ ይጠራቸዋል። በፊልጵስዩስ ልድያ ታምናለች፤ አንዲት ባሪያ ልጃገረድ ከመንፈስ ነጻ ትወጣለች፤ በእኩለ ሌሊት ከተከሰተው የምድር መናወጥ በኋላ የወኅኒ ቤቱ ጠባቂና ቤተ ሰቡ ይጠመቃሉ፤ ገዢዎቹም የሮም ዜጎች የሆኑትን ጳውሎስንና ሲላስን ይፈቷቸዋል።

17.en: Paul reasons from the Scriptures in Thessalonica, and the people of Berea examine the Scriptures daily. In Athens, a city full of idols, Paul speaks at the Areopagus about the unknown god who made the world and raised Jesus from the dead.
17.sw: Paulo anajadiliana kutoka katika Maandiko huko Thesalonike, na watu wa Beroya wanayachunguza Maandiko kila siku. Huko Athene, mji uliojaa sanamu, Paulo anazungumza kwenye Areopago kuhusu mungu asiyejulikana aliyeumba ulimwengu na kumfufua Yesu kutoka kwa wafu.
17.am: ጳውሎስ በተሰሎንቄ ከመጻሕፍት እየጠቀሰ ይከራከራል፤ የቤርያ ሰዎችም መጻሕፍትን በየቀኑ ይመረምራሉ። ጣዖታት በሞሉባት በአቴና ጳውሎስ በአርዮስፋጎስ ዓለምን ስለ ፈጠረውና ኢየሱስን ከሙታን ስላስነሣው ስለማይታወቀው አምላክ ይናገራል።

18.en: In Corinth Paul works with Aquila and Priscilla and stays a year and a half, encouraged by a vision, while Gallio refuses to hear the case against him. Paul returns to Antioch, and in Ephesus Apollos is taught the way of God more accurately.
18.sw: Huko Korintho Paulo anafanya kazi pamoja na Akila na Prisila na kukaa mwaka mmoja na nusu, akitiwa moyo na maono, huku Galio akikataa kusikiliza shauri dhidi yake. Paulo anarudi Antiokia, na huko Efeso Apolo anafundishwa njia ya Mungu kwa usahihi zaidi.
18.am: በቆሮንቶስ ጳውሎስ ከአቂላና ከጵርስቅላ ጋር ይሠራል፤ በራእይ ተበረታቶ ዓመት ተኩል ይቆያል፤ ጋልዮስም በእርሱ ላይ የቀረበውን ክስ ለመስማት እምቢ ይላል። ጳውሎስ ወደ አንጾኪያ ይመለሳል፤ በኤፌሶንም አጵሎስ የእግዚአብሔርን መንገድ ይበልጥ በትክክል ይማራል።

19.en: In Ephesus Paul baptizes disciples who knew only John's baptism and teaches for two years in the hall of Tyrannus. The sons of Sceva are overpowered, believers burn their books of magic, and the silversmiths stir up a riot in honor of Artemis of the Ephesians.
19.sw: Huko Efeso Paulo anawabatiza wanafunzi waliojua ubatizo wa Yohana tu na kufundisha kwa miaka miwili katika ukumbi wa mafundisho wa Tirano. Wana wa Skewa wanashindwa, waamini wanachoma vitabu vyao vya uchawi, na wafua fedha wanachochea ghasia kwa heshima ya Artemi wa Waefeso.
19.am: በኤፌሶን ጳውሎስ የዮሐንስን ጥምቀት ብቻ ያውቁ የነበሩትን ደቀ መዛሙርት ያጠምቃል፤ በጢራኖስ የትምህርት አዳራሽም ለሁለት ዓመት ያስተምራል። የአስቄዋ ልጆች ይሸነፋሉ፤ አማኞች የአስማት መጻሕፍታቸውን ያቃጥላሉ፤ የብር አንጥረኞችም ለኤፌሶናውያን አርጤምስ ክብር ሁከት ያስነሣሉ።

20.en: Paul travels through Macedonia and Greece, and at Troas raises Eutychus, who fell from a window. At Miletus Paul speaks to the elders of Ephesus, urging them to shepherd the church, and they part in tears.
20.sw: Paulo anasafiri kupitia Makedonia na Ugiriki, na huko Troa anamfufua Eutiko, aliyeanguka kutoka dirishani. Huko Mileto Paulo anazungumza na wazee wa Efeso, akiwahimiza kulichunga kanisa, nao wanaagana kwa machozi.
20.am: ጳውሎስ በመቄዶንያና በግሪክ ይጓዛል፤ በጢሮአዳም ከመስኮት የወደቀውን አውጤኪስን ከሞት ያስነሣል። በሚሊጢን ጳውሎስ ለኤፌሶን ሽማግሌዎች ይናገራል፤ ቤተ ክርስቲያንን እንዲጠብቁ ያሳስባቸዋል፤ በእንባም ይለያያሉ።

21.en: Paul sails to Tyre and Caesarea, where Agabus warns that Paul will be bound in Jerusalem. Paul meets with James and the elders, but in the temple a crowd seizes Paul, and the Roman tribune allows Paul to speak to the people.
21.sw: Paulo anasafiri kwa merikebu hadi Tiro na Kaisaria, ambapo Agabo anaonya kwamba Paulo atafungwa Yerusalemu. Paulo anakutana na Yakobo na wazee, lakini hekaluni umati unamkamata Paulo, na kamanda wa Kirumi anamruhusu Paulo kuzungumza na watu.
21.am: ጳውሎስ በመርከብ ወደ ጢሮስና ወደ ቂሣርያ ይጓዛል፤ በዚያም አጋቦስ ጳውሎስ በኢየሩሳሌም እንደሚታሰር ያስጠነቅቃል። ጳውሎስ ከያዕቆብና ከሽማግሌዎቹ ጋር ይገናኛል፤ በቤተ መቅደስ ግን ሕዝቡ ጳውሎስን ይይዙታል፤ የሮማዊው የሺህ አለቃም ጳውሎስ ለሕዝቡ እንዲናገር ይፈቅድለታል።

22.en: Paul tells the people of Jerusalem how the light from heaven stopped him near Damascus and how in a trance in the temple the Lord sent him to the Gentiles. The crowd erupts, and Paul, about to be flogged, says he is a Roman citizen by birth and is brought before the council.
22.sw: Paulo anawaambia watu wa Yerusalemu jinsi nuru kutoka mbinguni ilivyomsimamisha karibu na Dameski, na jinsi Bwana alivyomtuma kwa watu wa mataifa akiwa katika njozi hekaluni. Umati unalipuka, naye Paulo, akiwa karibu kuchapwa mijeledi, anasema kwamba yeye ni raia wa Kirumi kwa kuzaliwa, na kuletwa mbele ya Baraza Kuu.
22.am: ጳውሎስ ከሰማይ የወጣው ብርሃን በደማስቆ አቅራቢያ እንዴት እንዳስቆመውና በቤተ መቅደስ ተመስጦ ሳለ ጌታ ወደ አሕዛብ እንዴት እንደ ላከው ለኢየሩሳሌም ሕዝብ ይነግራቸዋል። ሕዝቡ ይቆጣሉ፤ ጳውሎስም ሊገረፍ ሲል በትውልድ የሮም ዜጋ እንደ ሆነ ይናገራል፤ በሸንጎውም ፊት ይቀርባል።

23.en: Paul divides the council over the resurrection, and that night the Lord tells him to take courage. When more than forty men swear to kill Paul, the tribune sends him by night to Felix the governor in Caesarea.
23.sw: Paulo analigawanya Baraza Kuu kuhusu ufufuo, na usiku ule Bwana anamwambia ajipe moyo. Wanaume zaidi ya arobaini wanapoapa kumuua Paulo, kamanda anampeleka usiku kwa mtawala Feliki huko Kaisaria.
23.am: ጳውሎስ ሸንጎውን ስለ ትንሣኤ ይከፋፍላል፤ በዚያም ሌሊት ጌታ እንዲበረታ ይነግረዋል። ከአርባ የሚበልጡ ሰዎች ጳውሎስን ለመግደል ሲማማሉ የሺህ አለቃው በሌሊት በቂሣርያ ወዳለው ወደ አገረ ገዥው ወደ ፊልክስ ይልከዋል።

24.en: Tertullus brings the case against Paul before Felix, and Paul answers that he worships the God of his ancestors and hopes in the resurrection. Felix and Drusilla hear Paul speak about faith in Jesus, but Felix keeps Paul in custody for two years.
24.sw: Tertulo analeta shauri dhidi ya Paulo mbele ya Feliki, naye Paulo anajibu kwamba anamwabudu Mungu wa babu zake na anatumaini ufufuo. Feliki na Drusila wanamsikia Paulo akizungumza juu ya imani katika Yesu, lakini Feliki anamweka Paulo kizuizini kwa miaka miwili.
24.am: ጠርጠሉስ በጳውሎስ ላይ ያለውን ክስ በፊልክስ ፊት ያቀርባል፤ ጳውሎስም የአባቶቹን አምላክ እንደሚያመልክና ትንሣኤን ተስፋ እንደሚያደርግ ይመልሳል። ፊልክስና ድሩሲላ ጳውሎስ በኢየሱስ ስላለው እምነት ሲናገር ይሰሙታል፤ ፊልክስ ግን ጳውሎስን ለሁለት ዓመት በእስር ያቆየዋል።

25.en: Festus hears Paul's case, and Paul appeals to Caesar. When King Agrippa and Bernice visit, Festus lays the case before them.
25.sw: Festo anasikiliza shauri la Paulo, naye Paulo anakata rufaa kwa Kaisari. Mfalme Agripa na Bernike wanapotembelea, Festo analieleza shauri hilo mbele yao.
25.am: ፊስጦስ የጳውሎስን ጉዳይ ይሰማል፤ ጳውሎስም ለቄሳር ይግባኝ ይላል። ንጉሥ አግሪጳና በርኒቄ ሲጎበኙ ፊስጦስ ጉዳዩን በፊታቸው ያቀርባል።

26.en: Paul makes his defense before Agrippa, telling of the light from heaven on the road to Damascus and his call to the Gentiles. Festus interrupts, Paul appeals to the king, and they agree that he has done nothing deserving death or chains.
26.sw: Paulo anajitetea mbele ya Agripa, akieleza habari ya nuru kutoka mbinguni katika barabara ya kwenda Dameski na wito wake kwa watu wa mataifa. Festo anamkatiza, Paulo anamsihi mfalme, nao wanakubaliana kwamba hajafanya kitu chochote kinachostahili kifo wala minyororo.
26.am: ጳውሎስ ወደ ደማስቆ በሚወስደው መንገድ ላይ ከሰማይ ስለ ወጣው ብርሃንና ወደ አሕዛብ ስለ ተጠራበት ጥሪ እየተናገረ በአግሪጳ ፊት ራሱን ይከላከላል። ፊስጦስ ያቋርጠዋል፤ ጳውሎስ ንጉሡን ይማጸናል፤ እነርሱም ለሞት ወይም ለእስራት የሚያበቃ ምንም ነገር እንዳላደረገ ይስማማሉ።

27.en: Paul sails for Italy as a prisoner, and a storm called Euraquilo drives the ship for many days. Paul encourages everyone to take heart and eat, and when the ship runs aground all reach land safely.
27.sw: Paulo anasafiri kwa merikebu kwenda Italia akiwa mfungwa, na dhoruba iitwayo Eurakilo inaipeleka merikebu kwa siku nyingi. Paulo anawatia wote moyo wajipe moyo na kula, na merikebu inapokwama wote wanafika nchi kavu salama.
27.am: ጳውሎስ እንደ እስረኛ በመርከብ ወደ ኢጣሊያ ይጓዛል፤ ኤውራቂሎን የሚባል ዐውሎ ነፋስም መርከቡን ለብዙ ቀናት ይነዳዋል። ጳውሎስ ሁሉም እንዲበረቱና እንዲበሉ ያበረታታቸዋል፤ መርከቡም ከአሸዋ ጋር ሲጣበቅ ሁሉም በሰላም ወደ የብስ ይደርሳሉ።

28.en: On Malta Paul is unharmed by a viper and heals many, among them the father of Publius. Paul reaches Rome, speaks with the Jewish leaders there, and for two years proclaims the kingdom of God unhindered.
28.sw: Huko Malta Paulo hadhuriki na nyoka mwenye sumu na kuponya wengi, miongoni mwao baba wa Publio. Paulo anafika Roma, anazungumza na viongozi wa Kiyahudi huko, na kwa miaka miwili anautangaza ufalme wa Mungu bila kuzuiliwa.
28.am: በመላጥያ ጳውሎስን እፉኝት አይጎዳውም፤ የፑብልዮስን አባት ጨምሮ ብዙዎችን ይፈውሳል። ጳውሎስ ሮም ይደርሳል፤ በዚያ ካሉት የአይሁድ መሪዎች ጋር ይነጋገራል፤ ለሁለት ዓመትም ያለ ምንም ከልካይ የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ይሰብካል።
